SOKOLOV, Boris Sergeyevich,
   D.Geol.Min.Sci., elected Academician Secretary on 26 Nov 1975
   of the Geology, Geophysics, Geochemistry and Mining Sciences
   Department and ex officio Presidium Member, born on 9 Apr 1914
   in Vyshnii Volochek in what is now Kalinin Oblast, read
   Geology at the A.A. Zhdanov Leningrad state University and
   graduated in 1937, joined the staff at the University at once
   and held several research and teaching positions 1937-1941,
   served with the Soviet Army during the Great Patriotic War
   1941-1945 and rejoined the staff 1945-1958 at Leningrad State
   University, appointed to the research staff in 1958 at the
   Institute of Geology and Geophysics (Novosibirsk) in the
   Siberian Department of the USSR Academy of Sciences where he
   worked for most of the rest of his career, originally elected
   a Corresponding Member in 1958 in the Geology, Geophysics,
   Geochemistry and Mining Sciences and Siberian Departments of
   the USSR Academy of Sciences, appointed to a senior teaching
   post in 1960 at Novosibirsk State University and became a full
   Professor there in 1964, elected a Member in 1963 of the
   Geological Society of France, 1967 Lenin Prizewinner, elected
   a Member in 1968 of the Geological Society of Sweden, elected
   an Academician on 26 Nov 1968 in the same Departments of USSR
 (Press F7 or Space to Exit, F2 to search, S to scan, t PgUp PgDn to position


   an Academician on 26 Nov 1968 in the same Departments of USSR
   Academy, elected Vice-President in 1972 of International
   Paleontological Union, elected President in 1974 of USSR All-
   Union Paleontological Society, elected a Member in 1975 of the
   Presidium of the USSR Academy, elected Chairman of the
   Interdepartmental committee on Stratigraphy of the USSR
   Academy of Sciences, 1979 A.P. Karpinskii Gold Medallist of
   the USSR Academy, conducted research into the geology and
   paleontology of corals, proterozoic and Cambrian organisms,
   the history of the development of the organic world during the
   Precambrian, the biostratigraphy and paleogeography of USSR
   territory during the first half of the Paleozoic, identified
   the "Wendu complex, awarded the Order of Lenin and two other
